passage.text: I am writing regarding my stay at the Blue Bay Hotel in Krabi last month, which I booked through your website.
passage.reading: aɪ æm ˈraɪtɪŋ rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ maɪ ˈsteɪ ət ðə ˈbluː ˈbeɪ hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈkrɑːbi ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, wɪtʃ aɪ ˈbʊkt θruː jʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt.

passage.text: According to the description on your website, every room had a sea view, and the hotel was five minutes from the beach.
passage.reading: əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən ɑːn jʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt, ˈɛvri ˈruːm ˈhæd ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː, ənd ðə hoʊˈtɛl wʌz ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts frəm ðə ˈbiːtʃ.

passage.text: I was also told that breakfast was included in the price.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈtoʊld ðæt ˈbrɛkfəst wʌz ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn ðə ˈpraɪs.

passage.text: Unfortunately, none of this was true.
passage.reading: ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, ˈnʌn əv ðɪs wʌz ˈtruː.

passage.text: From my window, I could only see a parking lot, and the beach was thirty minutes away by car.
passage.reading: frəm maɪ ˈwɪndoʊ, aɪ kʊd ˈoʊnli ˈsiː ə ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˌlɑːt, ənd ðə ˈbiːtʃ wʌz ˈθɜːrti ˈmɪnɪts əˈweɪ baɪ ˈkɑːr.

passage.text: Furthermore, I had to pay extra for breakfast every morning.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrðərmɔːr, aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈpeɪ ˈɛkstrə fər ˈbrɛkfəst ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: As a result, my stay cost almost four thousand baht more than I had planned.
passage.reading: əz ə rɪˈzʌlt, maɪ ˈsteɪ ˈkɔːst ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈfɔːr ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt ˈmɔːr ðən aɪ hæd ˈplænd.

passage.text: In addition, the air conditioning in my room was broken on the first night.
passage.reading: ɪn əˈdɪʃən, ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ ɪn maɪ ˈruːm wʌz ˈbroʊkən ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: When I complained, the hotel staff were rude and did not try to help me.
passage.reading: wɛn aɪ kəmˈpleɪnd, ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈstæf wɜːr ˈruːd ənd dɪd ˈnɑːt ˈtraɪ tə ˈhɛlp miː.

passage.text: This is unacceptable, and I am very dissatisfied with the service I received.
passage.reading: ðɪs ɪz ˌʌnəkˈsɛptəbəl, ənd aɪ æm ˈvɛri dɪsˈsætɪsfaɪd wɪð ðə ˈsɜːrvɪs aɪ rɪˈsiːvd.

passage.text: I would be grateful if you could give me a refund of fifty percent of the price.
passage.reading: aɪ wʊd bi ˈɡreɪtfəl ɪf juː kʊd ˈɡɪv miː ə ˈriːfʌnd əv ˈfɪfti pərˈsɛnt əv ðə ˈpraɪs.

passage.text: I would also appreciate it if you could change the description of this hotel on your website.
passage.reading: aɪ wʊd ˈɔːlsoʊ əˈpriːʃieɪt ɪt ɪf juː kʊd ˈtʃeɪndʒ ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən əv ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl ɑːn jʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt.

passage.text: I hope that you will resolve this matter as soon as possible.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðæt juː wɪl rɪˈzɑːlv ðɪs ˈmætər əz ˈsuːn əz ˈpɑːsəbəl.

passage.text: I look forward to your prompt reply.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə jʊr ˈprɑːmpt rɪˈplaɪ.
